question: What is the famous Japanese art of folding paper into beautiful shapes like birds and flowers called? 🦢
explanation: Great job! Origami is the traditional Japanese art of transforming a flat sheet of paper into a finished sculpture entirely through folding! 🦢
hint: It starts with the letter 'O'.

question: In the word 'Origami', what does the Japanese word 'kami' mean? 📄
explanation: Awesome! In Japanese, 'Ori' means folding, and 'kami' means paper. So together, it means folding paper! 📄
hint: It is the main material used in this craft.

question: What shape of paper is most commonly used to start a traditional Origami craft? 🟦
explanation: Brilliant! Most origami models start with a perfectly square sheet of paper to make sure the folds align beautifully! 🟦
hint: It has four equal sides.

question: Which of these tools is strictly NOT used in traditional Origami? ✂️
explanation: Fantastic! Traditional origami relies only on folding. Cutting with scissors or using glue is not allowed! ✂️
hint: It is a sharp tool used for cutting.

question: What do we call a fold that looks like a peak or an upside-down 'V' in origami? ⛰️
explanation: Excellent! When you fold the paper so the crease points upwards like a peak, it is called a Mountain fold! ⛰️
hint: Think of a tall, rocky peak.

question: What do we call an origami fold that sinks down to look like a 'V' shape? 🏞️
explanation: Super! When the crease is at the bottom and the paper folds up around it forming a 'V', it is a Valley fold! 🏞️
hint: It is the low area between two mountains.

question: Which beautiful folded bird is considered a worldwide symbol of peace in Origami? 🕊️
explanation: Wonderful! The origami crane is a beautiful bird that represents peace, hope, and healing all over the world! 🕊️
hint: It has a long neck and beautiful wings.

question: What is the best way to make a neat, sharp, and perfect fold in paper? 📏
explanation: Great job! Pressing down firmly to make a sharp crease ensures your paper craft looks neat and folds perfectly! 📏
hint: You can use your fingernail or a ruler to do this.

question: If you fold a square piece of paper in half diagonally, what new shape do you get? 📐
explanation: Awesome! Folding a square corner-to-corner (diagonally) perfectly creates a triangle! 🔺
hint: It has three sides.

question: Which of these is a popular moving origami toy that you can make at home? 🐸
explanation: Brilliant! You can fold paper to make a fun origami frog that actually jumps when you press its back! 🐸
hint: It is green and loves to hop.

question: What is the fun paper craft of interlacing paper strips to make a checkered pattern called? 🧺
explanation: Fantastic! Paper weaving is the wonderful craft of crossing strips over and under each other to make a solid sheet or mat! 🧺
hint: It is how baskets and clothes are made.

question: In basic paper weaving, what is the simple movement pattern we follow with the strips? 🎢
explanation: Excellent! The most basic weaving technique is simply taking the paper strip over one piece, then under the next! 🎢
hint: It is an alternating pattern.

question: In weaving, what do we call the stationary vertical strips of paper that act as the base? ⬇️
explanation: Super! The warp is the set of straight, stationary strips that you weave your other strips through! ⬇️
hint: It sounds like 'wrap' but spelled differently.

question: What do we call the horizontal strips of paper that we weave in and out across the base? ➡️
explanation: Wonderful! The weft strips are the ones you actively move left and right, over and under the warp strips! ➡️
hint: Weft moves Left and Right.

question: Which colorful everyday item can you easily make using the simple paper weaving technique? 🍱
explanation: Great job! A woven paper mat looks beautiful and can be used as a colorful table mat or a wall hanging! 🍱
hint: You can place your plate on it during dinner.

question: To make paper weaving look bright and beautiful, what kind of strips should we use? 🌈
explanation: Awesome! Using contrasting or bright, different colored strips makes the over-under woven pattern really stand out! 🌈
hint: Think of a rainbow.

question: What happens if you pull the woven paper strips too tight while making a mat? 🤏
options: The mat wrinkles and curls up 🥨
answer: The mat wrinkles and curls up 🥨
explanation: Brilliant! You must weave gently, because pulling the strips too tight will cause your beautiful flat mat to buckle and curl! 🥨
hint: The paper loses its flat shape.

question: How can we secure the loose ends of a woven paper mat so they don't open up? 🧴
explanation: Fantastic! Sticking the loose ends with a dab of glue or tape keeps your weaving pattern secure and locked in place! 🧴
hint: Use a sticky craft material.

question: Which material is best for weaving a sturdy and strong paper basket? 🗞️
explanation: Excellent! Thick chart paper or cardstock holds its shape very well, making it perfect for creating 3D woven baskets! 🗂️
hint: You need a paper that is stiff and strong.

question: What do paper weavers use to push the weft strips closely together to make a tight mat? 🖐️
explanation: Super! We simply use our fingers to gently push the strips close together so there are no gaps in the woven mat! 🖐️
hint: It is a part of your hand.

question: What does the French term 'Papier-Mâché' literally translate to? 🗞️
explanation: Wonderful! Papier-mâché literally means 'chewed paper' because the paper is torn and mashed up into a soft pulp! 🗞️
hint: Think of paper that has been crushed into a paste.

question: Which mixture is absolutely essential to make a strong papier-mâché paste? 🥣
explanation: Great job! Mixing paper with a sticky binder like glue or flour paste is the secret to making strong papier-mâché crafts! 🥣
hint: You need something sticky to hold it together.

question: What is the fun, hands-on first step in making papier-mâché pulp? ✂️
explanation: Awesome! Tearing old newspaper into small bits is the perfect first step before soaking them to make a soft pulp! 📄
hint: You use your hands to rip the paper.

question: Why do we soak torn newspaper pieces in water overnight for papier-mâché? 💧
options: To make the paper soft and mushy 🥣
To turn the paper into glass 🪟
answer: To make the paper soft and mushy 🥣
explanation: Brilliant! Soaking paper breaks down its fibers, turning it into a soft, clay-like mush that is easy to mold! 🥣
hint: Water makes hard things become soft.

question: Which object is commonly used as a base shape (or mold) to make a round papier-mâché bowl? 🎈
explanation: Fantastic! An inflated balloon provides the perfect round shape. Once the papier-mâché dries, you just pop the balloon! 🎈
hint: It is filled with air and floats at parties.

question: What is the most important step AFTER applying all the sticky papier-mâché layers to your craft? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! Papier-mâché needs plenty of time to dry completely in the sun or open air so it becomes solid and strong! ☀️
hint: It needs to sit in the sun for a while.

question: What happens to a wet papier-mâché bowl once it dries completely under the sun? 🪨
options: It becomes very hard and strong 🪨
It shrinks to the size of a pea 🌱
answer: It becomes very hard and strong 🪨
explanation: Super! Once all the water evaporates, the glue and paper fibers lock together to create a solid, hard, and lightweight object! 🪨
hint: It becomes like wood or plastic.

question: How can we beautifully decorate our papier-mâché bowl once it is fully dry? 🎨
options: By painting it with bright colors 🎨
answer: By painting it with bright colors 🎨
explanation: Wonderful! Dry papier-mâché has a great surface for painting, decorating with beads, and making your craft look colorful! 🎨
hint: Use a brush and palette.

question: Which eco-friendly and easily available material is mostly used in papier-mâché crafts? 📰
explanation: Great job! Using old, discarded newspapers is the best and most eco-friendly way to create beautiful papier-mâché art! 📰
hint: It is printed daily and has lots of news.

question: What acts as the 'binder' that holds the mashed paper together in papier-mâché? 🧴
explanation: Awesome! The glue or homemade flour paste acts as a binder, locking the paper pieces together so they don't fall apart! 🧴
hint: It is the sticky ingredient.

question: What is the beautiful art of tearing or cutting paper and sticking it together to make a picture called? 🖼️
explanation: Brilliant! A collage is made by assembling different pieces of paper, photographs, or fabric onto a single backing sheet! 🖼️
hint: It starts with the letter 'C'.

question: Which tool is the safest, neatest, and best for sticking light paper pieces in a scrapbook? 🖍️
explanation: Fantastic! A glue stick is perfect for paper crafts because it is neat, doesn't spill, and keeps your paper from getting too wet! 🖍️
hint: It looks like a tube of lip balm but is sticky.

question: If you fold a paper in half and cut out half of a heart shape, what do you get when you open it? ❤️
explanation: Excellent! Cutting on a folded edge is a smart trick to create perfectly symmetrical shapes where both sides are exactly the same! ❤️
hint: Both sides will perfectly match each other.

question: What is the fun technique of creating a 3D picture that jumps out when you open a folded card? 💌
explanation: Super! Pop-up cards use special cuts and folds so that parts of the paper stand up in 3D when the card is opened! 💌
hint: It 'pops' out at you!

question: Which crafting item should you always handle with care and sometimes ask for adult supervision to use? ✂️
explanation: Wonderful! Scissors are sharp tools used for cutting paper, so we must always use them carefully to stay safe! ✂️
hint: It has sharp blades.

question: When making a beautiful paper snowflake, what is the most important step before you start cutting? ❄️
explanation: Great job! Folding the paper into a small triangle before cutting ensures that your snowflake has a beautiful, repeating pattern! ❄️
hint: You need to crease it several times first.

question: Which paper craft involves rolling thin, colorful strips of paper into beautiful, tight coils? 🌀
explanation: Awesome! Quilling (or paper filigree) is the lovely art of rolling, shaping, and gluing thin paper strips to make designs! 🌀
hint: It sounds like the name of a bird's feather.

question: What simple geometry tool is very helpful to make a perfectly straight fold or crease in thick paper? 📏
explanation: Brilliant! Placing a ruler along the line and folding the paper over it guarantees a perfectly straight and sharp crease! 📏
hint: It is a long, straight measuring tool.

question: What is a creative and fun way to recycle old, useless magazines at home? ✂️
options: Use them for colorful paper collages 🖼️
answer: Use them for colorful paper collages 🖼️
explanation: Fantastic! Magazines are full of bright colors and pictures, making them excellent free material for tearing and making collages! 🖼️
hint: Cut out the bright pictures to make art.

question: What type of paper is thick, stiff, and great for making greeting cards or 3D models? 🗂️
explanation: Excellent! Cardstock and chart paper are thicker and stronger than normal paper, helping your cards and models stand upright! 🗂️
hint: It is heavier and stiffer than notebook paper.

question: What do we call a paper model that has height, width, and depth, and can stand up on its own? 🏠
explanation: Super! A 3D (three-dimensional) paper model, like a folded paper house, has volume and can stand securely on your desk! 🏠
hint: It has three dimensions.

question: How can you easily make a flat paper strip curly and bouncy like a spring? ✏️
options: By wrapping it tightly around a pencil ✏️
answer: By wrapping it tightly around a pencil ✏️
explanation: Wonderful! Curling a paper strip around a cylindrical object like a pencil gives it a fun, bouncy, spring-like shape! ✏️
hint: Use a round writing tool.

question: Which of these is a popular Indian festival craft traditionally made using colorful paper? 🏮
explanation: Great job! Paper lanterns (Kandils) are beautifully crafted from bright papers and are a famous decoration during Diwali! 🏮
hint: It is hung outside during Diwali.

question: When tearing paper by hand for a soft collage, what kind of edges do you usually get? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Hand-tearing paper creates soft, feathered edges that give your collage a wonderful, organic texture! ☁️
hint: It doesn't look like it was cut with scissors.

question: What is the best way to clean your hands after doing sticky papier-mâché or pasting work? 🧼
options: Wash them well with soap and water 🧼
answer: Wash them well with soap and water 🧼
explanation: Brilliant! Always wash your hands properly with soap and water after art projects to keep them clean and germ-free! 🧼
hint: Use bubbles at the sink.

question: To make a simple paper fan, what type of fold do we use repeatedly? 🪭
explanation: Fantastic! Folding the paper back and forth in a zig-zag pattern (accordion fold) makes a perfect, breezy paper fan! 🪭
hint: It goes back and forth like a zig-zag.

question: Which paper craft technique uses multiple layers of thin tissue paper to make colorful fluffy flowers? 🌺
explanation: Excellent! By stacking, folding, tying the center, and fluffing up tissue paper layers, you can create gorgeous paper flowers! 🌺
hint: You have to gently pull the layers apart.

question: What is the visible line called where you press the paper down to fold it? ➖
explanation: Super! A crease is the line or mark made by folding, pressing, or crushing the paper. Good creases make good crafts! ➖
hint: It is the folded line.

question: If your white liquid paper glue is too thick to spread easily, what can you safely mix into it? 💧
explanation: Wonderful! Adding just a tiny drop of water to white school glue thins it out, making it perfectly spreadable for your craft! 💧
hint: It comes out of the tap.

question: Why is paper craft such a wonderful and popular activity for everyone? 🌟
options: It helps us be creative, focus, and have fun 🌟
answer: It helps us be creative, focus, and have fun 🌟
explanation: Great job! Paper craft builds imagination, improves motor skills, and gives us the joy of creating beautiful things with our own hands! 🌟
hint: It is a positive, happy activity.
